questions.q: What turns a tabular report into a summary report?
options: Adding a grouping in the Outline tab
Saving it to a shared folder
questions.explain: Adding a group (Add group... under Groups on the Outline tab) is what converts the report to a Summary format.

questions.q: Which SQL concept corresponds to a grouping in a summary report?
questions.explain: A report grouping is equivalent to a GROUP BY column, and the summaries per group are like aggregate functions.

questions.q: How many grouping levels can a summary report have?
questions.explain: Summary reports support up to three levels of grouping. For grouping in both rows and columns, use a matrix.

questions.q: How does a summary report differ from a plain GROUP BY query result?
options: It keeps the detail rows beneath each group so you can drill into them
It only returns one row per report
questions.explain: A report shows subtotals and also the underlying records for each group, while a GROUP BY query returns only the aggregated rows.

questions.q: Why are summary reports commonly used as dashboard sources?
options: Dashboards can only read reports with three columns
Groupings provide an axis for charts to plot against
Summary reports refresh faster than any other format
Summary reports are the only format that supports filters
questions.explain: Charts need something to group by. The report's grouping supplies the axis, and the summarized value supplies the measure.
